## Incidents

Routine checks are performed at the start of each working day and the results recorded in the shared operations log.

Where a check fails, the on-call engineer raises a ticket before attempting any remediation.

Alert thresholds are reviewed quarterly; changes require sign-off from the service owner.

Incident reviews are held within five working days and produce a short written summary.
